saw_lines: Buyers replace cookware once a pan wears out, then judge the brand on its health claims and proof before they click.
So trust has to sit in the first line, or the buyer never reaches your offer.
Your site shows 200,000+ Reviews, yet 0 of 28 live ads carry a proof number. Put 200,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 200,000+ Reviews, yet 0 of 28 live ads carry a proof number, so cold buyers lack a reason to trust you. Put 200,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it and only 5 of 22 mention any offer, so buyers see no saving to act on. Put the subscribe offer in the first line of three new ads.

Your site runs a subscribe offer, yet 0 of 28 live ads mention a subscription, so repeat buyers never hear about the saving. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at past buyers.
Three of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not a product page, so the buyer has to hunt for the item they clicked. Point each of those ads to the product on screen, not the home page.
